Due dates and discounts

The school lists the 10th of each month as the payment deadline and a ₹300 daily late fee. Its published schedule offers a 5% discount on full-year payment. The fee schedule lists eligible modes, additional charges, and exceptions for holidays.

Payment and withdrawals

The school lists payment through its app or portal, by cheque or demand draft, or at the school counter. Its schedule lists a ₹1,250 transfer certificate fee. Check the original schedule for the full non-payment and withdrawal terms.
